answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 7 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the copper release is entered with every signature, the kernel audit shows the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, as each signer must be independent on the plume graph and each risks its bond. The deposit is 48 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
